text: In Cosmological Natural Selection, universes reproduce through black holes with slightly changed constants. Those constants should sit near values that favor black hole production. In the Brown-Li-Ro chain, Lana surveyed the Brown-Bethy maximum neutron star mass is about one and a half times the mass of our sun, 1.5 solar masses. Their paper says a neutron star at approximately two solar masses or above would put that chain in serious doubt or simply falsify it. That is a real falsifiable number.
